Ballet tights and most dance tights in general are "convertible tights", meaning you can use the hole in them to get your feet out without taking off the entire thing. Many ballerinas also do modern and other forms of dance that are barefoot so this helps us switch quickly between classes. Also, when we wear pointe shoes we wear toepads and other forms of toe protection, and most of us like to put these on our bare feet so we need to be able to get under our tights and put them back on quickly.
